path_is_reconstructed.instructions: Does the diff in `files['src/new_eden_gates.cpp']` reconstruct an ordered sequence of system ids, not merely a hop integer?

criteria.true: ShortestRoute fills systemIds via a parent chain.
criteria.false: Only HopDistance's integer remains.

path_is_graph_derived.instructions: Is the Jita-Amarr system sequence derived by BFS on the loaded graph rather than a hard-coded list of names or ids?

criteria.true: Parents come from adjacency traversal of Graph edges.
criteria.false: The sequence is a literal array of systems.

starts_at_jita.instructions: Do validation and the host require the reconstructed route to start at kJitaId / Jita?

criteria.true: Front id is kJitaId and the name is checked as Jita.
criteria.false: Start is not checked.

ends_at_amarr.instructions: Do validation and the host require the reconstructed route to end at kAmarrId / Amarr?

criteria.true: Back id is kAmarrId and the name is checked as Amarr.
criteria.false: End is not checked.

hop_count_still_11.instructions: Is the expected hop count still 11 (kExpectedJitaAmarrHops) and enforced on the reconstructed path length?

criteria.false: The 11-hop check was removed or replaced with a hard-coded path.

consecutive_pairs_are_edges.instructions: Does ValidateGraph check that every consecutive pair on the reconstructed route exists as a loaded undirected stargate edge?

criteria.true: ConsecutivePairsAreEdges looks up sorted pairs in the edge set.
criteria.false: Only hop count is checked.

normal_gates_still_drawn.instructions: Does `files['src/neweden_main.cpp']` still draw the full static gate network with DrawPrimitive(0, edgeCount) on the original gate buffer?

criteria.false: Normal gates were removed or replaced by the route.

route_is_separate_buffer.instructions: Is the route a separate static TOP_LINES buffer rather than mutating the full gate vertex buffer?

criteria.false: The gate buffer is rewritten.

route_is_brighter.instructions: Is the route drawn with a higher intensity (kRouteIntensity 1.0) than the subdued gates (kGateIntensity 0.22) using the same grayscale shader?

criteria.false: Route and gates use the same 0.22 intensity or a new coloured shader.

no_sqlite_esi.instructions: Did this diff add SQLite, ESI, or other network/data-source dependencies?

criteria.false: Still local binaries only.

no_new_shader_or_cmake_app.instructions: Did the implementation add a new HLSL shader, CMake executable, or vcpkg dependency?

criteria.false: Only gates + neweden_main (+ a Python checker) using existing shaders.

triangle_starfield_untouched.instructions: According to `files['git_diff_stat']`, were triangle_main.cpp and starfield_main.cpp left unchanged?

criteria.true: Those files are not in the diff.
criteria.false: They were edited.

no_route_ui.instructions: Did the diff add route UI, search, picking, or origin/destination controls?

criteria.false: The Jita-Amarr route is automatic with no new UI.

draw_calls_are_three.instructions: Is kDrawCallsPerFrame now 3 (gate lines, route lines, points)?

criteria.false: Still two, or some other number.

route_depth_relaxed.instructions: Is the route overlay drawn with depth test/write disabled so it is not z-fought against the identical gate segments, then depth restored before points?

criteria.true: RS_ZENABLE and RS_ZWRITEENABLE are 0 for the route pass and restored afterward.
criteria.false: Route uses the same depth state as gates with no overlay handling.

graph_type_not_duplicated.instructions: Did the diff introduce a second graph class/framework besides Graph plus the existing local adjacency map used for BFS?

criteria.true: A new graph type was added.
criteria.false: ShortestRoute reuses Graph and BuildAdjacency.

smoke_claims_pixels.instructions: Do the new comments or smoke logs claim that automated --smoke proves the route pixels look correct?

criteria.true: The code/docs claim pixel proof from smoke.
criteria.false: Smoke still only proves init/draw/Present; visual look is for a human.

niarja_still_unreachable.instructions: Is the Niarja-unreachable check still present after routing was added?

criteria.false: That check was removed.

names_logged_from_catalogue.instructions: Are route system names formatted from the loaded catalogue at runtime rather than a hard-coded name string?

criteria.false: A literal name list is printed.

jump_bridges_added.instructions: Did the diff add jump bridges, Ansiblex, security avoidance, or W-space?

criteria.false: Ordinary stargates only.

path_source.instructions: Where does the ordered Jita-Amarr route come from?

criteria.bfs_parents_on_loaded_graph: ShortestRoute BFS parent reconstruction on Graph.
criteria.hardcoded_system_list: A fixed array of system ids/names.

gate_network_fate.instructions: What happened to the ordinary gate network draw?

criteria.unchanged_full_buffer: Still one static TOP_LINES buffer of all undirected gates, drawn first.
criteria.route_edges_removed: Route edges were stripped from the gate buffer.

new_dependencies.instructions: What new runtime dependencies does this milestone add to the New Eden executable?

criteria.new_shader_pipeline: A new fxc shader target is required to run.

validation_adequacy.instructions: How adequate is the code-side route validation versus the milestone requirements?

criteria.endpoints_hops_edges: Starts Jita, ends Amarr, 11 hops, consecutive pairs are real edges, Niarja still unreachable.

requirements_gap.instructions: Which required behaviour appears unimplemented in the diff?

criteria.none_for_this_milestone: Ordered graph-derived Jita-Amarr path, separate brighter overlay, normal gates remain, no UI/ESI.
criteria.no_actual_path: Hop count only; no ordered path.
criteria.no_visual_overlay: Path exists but is not drawn.

regression_risk.instructions: How large is the regression surface of this diff relative to frozen triangle/starfield hosts and the existing gate draw?

criteria.scoped_neweden_gates: Edits are in neweden_main and new_eden_gates; triangle/starfield untouched; gate buffer still static.

pixel_evidence.instructions: What does a passing --smoke run prove about the highlighted route?

criteria.init_draw_present_and_route_log: Init, draws, Present, logged route names/hops, exit 0. Not pixel aesthetics.
criteria.pixels_proven: Smoke proves the overlay looks correct on screen.
